load_dataset_dicts: load LVIS dataset annotations from a JSON file into a list of dataset dictionaries
repeat_factors_from_category_frequency: compute repeat factors for each image based on category frequency to balance rare categories
create_RepeatFactorTrainingSampler: create a distributed sampler that repeats rare category images using stochastic rounding for balanced training
create_DistributedSampler: create a distributed sampler that splits dataset indices evenly across multiple training processes
create_NodeDistributedSampler: create a node-aware distributed sampler that partitions data by local rank within each node
